item.title: Two killed, two hurt in Dillon shooting Monday night
item.description: DILLON, S.C. (WBTW) -- Two people were killed and two others hurt Monday night in at least one shooting in Dillon, Coroner Donnie Grimsley said. No further details were immediately available, including a location or identities of the victims. Count on News13 for updates on-air and online. This is a developing story.

item.title: Cold morning, normal March afternoon
item.description: We’ll see a mix of sun and clouds today, though not as persistently cloudy as yesterday. Temperatures will warm up more quickly, reaching near-normal levels. Highs will climb into the mid-60s along the coast and the upper 60s across the Pee Dee.
